chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdillāh ibn Marwān al-Anbārī, who said:

I was present at the passing of Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī (عليه السلام). Then Abū al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) came, and a chair was placed for him, so he sat upon it, and around him were the members of his household, while Abū Muḥammad was standing in a corner. Then when he had finished with the matter of Abū Jaʿfar, he turned toward Abū Muḥammad (عليه السلام) and said: “O my son, renew gratitude to Allah, Blessed and Exalted, for He has brought about in you a matter.”

key_terms.أَمْرًا: a significant matter or affair brought about by Allah
key_terms.يَا بُنَيَّ: an affectionate address meaning: O my son

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the designation of Abū Muḥammad al-Ḥasan al-ʿAskarī (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report narrates a moment at the passing of Abū Jaʿfar Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī (عليه السلام), when Abū al-Ḥasan (عليه السلام) publicly addressed Abū Muḥammad (عليه السلام). His instruction to give shukr to Allah indicates the occurrence of a significant divinely ordained matter concerning him, understood in this chapter as a designation connected to the Imamate.
